name: Bluefors Oy
description: Bluefors is a world-leading manufacturer of ultra-low temperature measurement systems and cryogenic dilution refrigerators. The company provides critical cryogenic infrastructure for quantum computing systems, enabling quantum processors to operate at the near-absolute-zero temperatures required for quantum coherence. Bluefors systems are used by quantum computing companies and research institutions globally.

news.title: Bluefors launches Modular Cryogenic Platform for scalable quantum systems
news.excerpt: New modular architecture is designed to scale quantum infrastructure toward hundreds of thousands of qubits; first multi-module delivery slated for late 2026.

news.title: Bluefors opens Chicago lab at Hyde Park Labs and joins Chicago Quantum Exchange
news.excerpt: Bluefors celebrated the grand opening of its expanded Bluefors Lab Chicago at the UChicago Science Incubator, providing early-stage startups and researchers with access to cryogenic measurement systems, and joined the Chicago Quantum Exchange to support regional quantum infrastructure and workforce development.
